physics.model: single-band effective mass: Gamma conduction band + heavy-hole band, no k.p coupling

structure: Demo 20 case 04 'Linear 1.0 nm': GaAs wells 7.1 nm and 2.9 nm separated by a 1.8 nm Al0.55Ga0.45As tunnel barrier, Al0.55Ga0.45As period barrier, 30 nm period, 1 nm linear grading at all four interfaces; quantum region 7.1-22.9 nm with Dirichlet boundaries
provenance: Byte-identical copy of the tracked historical folder docs/case_04 (Demo 20 case 04, run on the WORK laptop). The historical folder is not moved or edited.
notes: Demo 28A and Demo 30 read the k=0 anchors (e1, e2, hh1, hh2) and the envelopes behind O, z_e and z_h. Demo 30 also reads all six Gamma and six HH states for the expanded_bound_states comparison, and bandedges.dat for the validity window. logs/stdout.txt contains the licensee line; this folder is local-only and never committed.
